non_blocking_observation: The frozen contract pins for all three acceptance receipts match current local receipt hashes; each receipt names the intended run, selected_epoch=2, and its checkpoint/model/provenance digests match the contract. This observation validates metadata pins only.
required_final_source_checks: The launch argv itself does not specify batch=16, chunk=4000, or the exact first-16-groups/20,000-step profile boundary. The new profile-only source must enforce these frozen contract values and emit them in a receipt that root can check; otherwise the invocation is not yet bound to the contract.
The template sets inference precision fp32 but does not explicitly disable TF32. The new source must set TF32 false (and report it) to satisfy the frozen resource/numerics contract.

The template records source_commit and validates each embedded file against its own supplied SHA, but does not verify that file inventory against a separate source manifest or git tree. Final packet review/root admission should bind the exact source commit, complete inventory, and embedded payload/body hashes before launch.
review_limits: This is a template-level conditional review, not approval of final embedded payload bytes or the new source commit.
No profile result, prediction/cache artifact, or model-quality claim is established.

reviewed_guards.create_only_staging: Requires source and output absent/non-symlink, writes staged files with exclusive-create mode, checks each base64 file byte count and SHA, and verifies the staged regular-file inventory equals the supplied payload inventory.
reviewed_guards.launch_envelope: Uses one CPU quota, 7.5-GB MemoryHigh, 8-GB MemoryMax, no swap, 600-second runtime, selected-GPU visibility, FP32 inference flag, zero loader workers, and fresh output paths.
reviewed_guards.reused_resource_gates: Executes the SHA-pinned existing read-only profile helpers, then binds selected GPU UUID, raises free-memory reservation to 4 GiB allocator plus 1 GB reserve, checks 1-CPU parent headroom/campaign descendants, data identity, persistent scratch and disk headroom, and stop-marker/unit absence.
reviewed_guards.teacher_inputs: For each contract teacher, requires accepted receipt bytes to match pinned acceptance SHA, status ACCEPTED and checkpoint SHA; freshly hashes model_ep2.pt and provenance.json against contract pins.

scope: Static local review of the short profile-only admission template and frozen cache execution contract. No SSH, tests, model/payload reads, or remote action.
